trajectory.note: Only Copilot's final structured response was captured. No separate observable step-by-step trajectory trace was preserved, so no trajectory score is fabricated.

interpretation: Copilot matched the human Gold decision and operational disposition, identified all load-bearing technical findings, preserved the missing cross-day requirement as a control gap rather than an automatic pass, recommended the required scope change and additional data collection, and preserved human promotion authority.
protocol_limitations: The external Copilot session and exact underlying model/version were user-mediated and not independently verifiable by Evaluator OS.

The human Gold reviewer saw the Copilot candidate response before submitting Gold, so Mission 002 is not reviewer-blind adjudication and is not clean evidence for judge calibration or inter-rater independence.
No separate observable candidate trajectory was captured, so trajectory scoring is intentionally omitted.
claim_boundary: This is one candidate run aligned to one human-verified Mission 002 Gold task. Combined with Mission 001, the registry contains two human-verified Gold tasks. This remains exploratory and is insufficient for general model-performance, evaluator-reliability, calibration, or inter-rater agreement claims.
